title: Distributed Database: Supplementary Exam, August 2018
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS

parts.text: Explain the following terms as used in the database concurrency transactions
Deletion anomaly.
Update anomaly.
Insertion anomaly.
Using a diagram, discuss the architecture of a distributed DBMS architecture.
Describe any five characteristics of a distributed databases systems.
Explain three design issues that come with distributed database design.
Explain FOUR advantages of distributed databases.
Using examples explain the differences between Horizontal and vertical fragmentation .
Describe the purpose of transaction logs.
Explain the term transaction log as used in DDBMS.
Recovery in a distributed DBMS is more complicated than in a centralized DBMS. Explain
Explain the additional functions that a DDBMS have over a Centralized DBMS.
Briefly discuss the rules that one has to satisfy when performing fragmentation.
By use of simple examples, write appropriate SQL statements to explain the concepts of left inner join and right outer join.
Describe any Five database security threats giving the mechanism against each.
Explain any three issues that have to be considered in query optimization.
Explain the Two ways for the Local Recovery Management uses to deal with update/write operations
Describe the description for a database administrator at MKU.
Explain Two Phase Commit Protocol (2PC).
